channel.title: Artificial Intelligence :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Proposed for Fall 2027, the Artificial Intelligence degree builds upon the department’s expertise and existing courses in AI, machine learning, and knowledge representation to present a cohesive synthesis of modern AI techniques and architectures. As a specialization degree, students earning a Bachelors in AI will also earn a Bachelors of Computer Science with no additional coursework required. The Bachelor of Artificial Intelligence will be reviewed by ABET for accreditation in our next cycle.
